business-cycle.def: The repeated rise and fall of real GDP around its trend: an expansion (rising output) and a contraction (falling output), with a peak and a trough as the turning points. A severe, lasting contraction is a recession.

potential-output.def: The real GDP an economy produces when unemployment is at its natural rate: full-employment output. It grows over time.

output-gap.def: Real GDP minus potential output. A negative (recessionary) gap means output is below potential and there is cyclical unemployment; a positive (inflationary) gap means output is above potential.
